title: Nordic and Baltic parliamentary speakers meet in Iceland
summary_full: The speakers of the Nordic and Baltic parliaments are meeting in Iceland on Thursday and Friday for their annual get-together and to observe the referendum on the resumption of Iceland's European Union membership negotiations.
